tha-ap192:1.1: abhibhūtaṁ → abhibhūto (bj) | abhibhūtaṁ panijjhanti → abhibhuṁ theraṁ panijjhāma (sya-all) | panijjhanti → abhibhuṁ vopanijjhanti (bj: PTS) | panijjhanti → abhibhūtopanijjhanti (cck: sī.)

tha-ap192:2.4: santikaṁ → santike (bj, sya-all, pts) | āgacchi → āgañchi (sya-all)
tha-ap192:3.1: baddhacarā → paṭṭhacarā (sya-all); paddhacarā (pts) | paddhacarā → S2 paṭṭhañcarā; G. paṭṭhacārā; cf. p. 185. (pts note)
tha-ap192:4.1: kālaṅkato → kālakato (bj) | sohaṁ kālaṅkato → so haṁ kālakato (pts)
tha-ap192:4.4: gacchahaṁ → gañchahaṁ (sya-all) | agacch → S2 n'; agañch'. (pts note)

tha-ap192:11.1: Kuṭajo → G. S1 Kuṭajā. (pts note) | Bandhujīvī → S2 Bandhujīvi. (pts note)
tha-ap192:11.2: koṭumbarikahatthiyo → kotumbarikahatthiyo (sya-all) | Koṭumbarika → G. Kotuppariya; S1 Kotumbariya. (pts note)
tha-ap192:11.3: bodhi → bodhī (bj) | Bodhī → G. Bodhi. (pts note)
